name: The New Revolution
caption: A tag team that beat Marcus Mann and Leo Cartier before falling just short of the Big Apple Tag Team Championship against the New Generation.

tenures.source: The fed's own 5 February 1998 broadcast ("BAWF Blood & Guts"). The fed's own 27 February 1998 broadcast ("BAWF Friday Night Heat").

name: The New Generation
caption: Big Apple Tag Team Champions through the spring of 1998, retaining the belts against the New Revolution on Friday Night Heat.

tenures.source: The fed's own 5 February 1998 broadcast ("BAWF Blood & Guts"). The fed's own 27 February 1998 broadcast ("BAWF Friday Night Heat").

identity.note: A different tag team of the same name is recorded elsewhere in the held record's other federations; nothing in this wing's own served record links the two.

name: Hard Stuff
caption: A BAWF tag team beaten by the New Generation on the fed's own 5 February 1998 broadcast; no individual roster survives in the record.

tenures.source: The fed's own 5 February 1998 broadcast ("BAWF Blood & Guts").

name: The Schianos
caption: Brothers who beat The 911 Kid and Ward Enigma by disqualification on the fed's own 5 February 1998 broadcast.

tenures.source: The fed's own 5 February 1998 broadcast ("BAWF Blood & Guts").

name: The Evil Empire
caption: The reigning Big Apple Tag Team Champions, retaining the belts in a three-way elimination match against the Fire Brothers and the Glory Knights on the fed's own 24 May 1998 broadcast.

tenures.source: The fed's own broadcast posted 24 May 1998 ("BAWF Friday Night Heat").

identity.note: A different persona of the same name is recorded elsewhere in the held record's other federations; nothing in this wing's own served record links the two.

name: The Fire Brothers
caption: A tag team who entered the ring by gold-and-white carriage; eliminated first from a three-way Big Apple Tag Team Championship match on the fed's own 24 May 1998 broadcast.

tenures.source: The fed's own broadcast posted 24 May 1998 ("BAWF Friday Night Heat").

name: The Glory Knights
caption: A tag team who lost a three-way Big Apple Tag Team Championship match to the Evil Empire on the fed's own 24 May 1998 broadcast.

tenures.source: The fed's own broadcast posted 24 May 1998 ("BAWF Friday Night Heat").

name: Powers of Arrogance
caption: An NWC-affiliate tag team who won the alliance's own World Tag Team Championship by forfeit, then expanded into a five-man faction with two of the fed's own top singles stars.
notes: The fed's own 12 April 1998 broadcast shows the team publicly recruiting "Hollywood" Tony Pride and Shawn "Bullseye" Arrows into an expanded five-man version of the group the same night; Pride and Arrows are not added to this unit's own roster here, since neither wrestles as part of it on any served card this pass.

tenures.source: The fed's own 12 April 1998 Friday Night Heat broadcast.
